full_judgment: 2. The facts relevant for disposal of the Rule, in short, are that Satish Chandra Datta and Ramesh Chandra Datta were the CS recorded tenant of the land under CS Khatian No. 1072 in the year 1941. Petitioner's father Abdul Aziz took settlement of 0.2385 acre land of CS Plot No. 1075 as under Raiyat under Satish Chandra Datta and Ramesh Chandra Datta. The father of the petitioner was possessing the land by paying rents to the original tenants by rent receipts. In the year 1971 during the Liberation War the rent receipts along with other documents of Abdul Aziz were destroyed. After the independence of the country Satish Chandra Datta and Ramesh Chandra Datta secretly tried to sale the land to elsewhere. Having come to know about the sale, the petitioner's father expressed his desire to purchase the land but Satish Chandra Datta and Ramesh Chandra Datta refused to sale the land to the father of the petitioner. They directed the petitioner's father to leave the possession of the land but Abdul Aziz, the father of the petitioner notoriously refused the title of Satish Chandra Datta and Ramesh Chandra Datta. Thereafter, the father of the petitioner excavated a pond in the suit land and by operation of law the status of Abdul Aziz as tenant was upgraded under Government. Abdul Aziz showed his papers to the employees of settlement and survey for the purpose of preparation of SA record in the name of Abdul Aziz. While Abdul Aziz was possessing the land by excavating pond thereon and by doing pisciculture there in the 1st week of June 1974 he orally gifted the land to his son, the petitioner and delivered possesion of the pond in favour of the petitioner. In the year 1976 petitioner's father died and in the year 1995 the petitioner desired to fill up the pond by earth with a view to constructing a market and residential house by taking loan from the Bank. For that purpose he went to the Office of the Tahsilder in the month of March 1995 and came to know that the land has been wrongly recorded in the name of the Government under Khas Khatian No. 1.
